items.item: This topic leaves out the quality-framework mechanics, the lineage model and impact analysis, burn-rate alerting, and the incident-response process itself.
Declarative and statistical data-quality checks, lineage-based alert routing, and suppression-and-feedback design are each established practice, not an emerging technique.
